title: The Payment Screenshot
intro: You are selling your old bicycle for ₹6,500 on Tradely. A buyer says he has paid.
This time you can talk back. Pick your replies and sniff each message as it arrives.
Every chat ends with your choice. Choose wisely.

notify.text: I have paid! Please check the screenshot…

banner: Chat opened on Tradely, moved to texts at his request

msg.text: Let us skip the app and do this by text.

msg: Send the bicycle with my courier now.

replies.text: Let me check my bank first

msg: The bank is slow on Sundays.

msg.text: Return the extra ₹10,000 to me and send the bicycle.

replies.text: A screenshot proves nothing. I only trust my own bank balance.

msg.text: You are wasting my time. Do it or I will write a bad review!

replies.text: Money is not in my account, so no bicycle. I will tell Tradely.

offsite.label: Off the marketplace
offsite.lens: He wants to leave the app and talk by text.
offsite.why: Scammers move you away from the safety of the marketplace.

paid.label: "I have paid"
paid.lens: Money is claimed, but nothing has arrived in your account.
paid.why: Only your own bank or payment app can tell you a payment arrived.

shot.label: A screenshot as proof
shot.lens: A picture is not a payment. Anyone can make one in seconds.
shot.why: Never trust a screenshot. Trust your own account balance.

screenshot.label: "The screenshot is enough"
screenshot.lens: He pushes you to accept the picture.
screenshot.why: An honest buyer waits while you check.

over.label: Overpayment and "send back"
over.lens: He says he overpaid and asks you to return the extra.
over.why: Sending back "extra" money is a classic trick: the first payment never existed.

angry.label: Anger and threats
angry.lens: A bad-review threat to make you rush.
angry.why: Pressure is the tool. An honest buyer is patient.

actions.label: Send the bicycle or the extra money
Wait until the money is in my own account

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. Tradely removed the fake buyer before he reached another seller.

verify.line: Your own account showed no payment at all. No money, no bicycle. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The payment never existed. You lost the bicycle, or ₹10,000, or both.

what_if.go_ahead: Looking at your own account balance would have ended it in one tap. Nothing arrived.
what_if.verify: Waiting for the money to appear in your own account is the right habit. Reporting the buyer as well protects others.

golden_rule: A screenshot is not a payment. Only your own account balance is proof. Never send "extra" money back.

quick_check.q: A buyer sends a screenshot saying he paid and asks you to ship now. What proves he paid?

options.text: The money showing in your own account
A promise to review you well

quick_check.explain: Only your own account shows a payment. Pictures are easy to fake.

hints.nudge: Where would you see a real payment?

rows.k: Pay and sell inside the marketplace
A check or payment with "send back the extra"
rows.v: A scam, the first payment is fake
